desc: 205 per-CPU sysreg diff (Mythos-suggested cheaper first step, 2026-10-25). READS ONLY via m1n1 proxy mrs under the exception guard: scripts/t6040-cpu-sysreg-diff.py. No msr, no MMIO, no SPMI. Motivation: m1n1 chickens.c has NULL init for all M4 cores; the boot core is iBoot-configured, secondaries are raw. Output JSON evidence.
